causal_chain.finding: CodeModeHost is stable and enabled by default.
Fixture cargo_bin(host).ok() drops missing metadata; no explicit override is installed unless a path resolves.
With CodeModeHost enabled, ordinary constructor uses ProcessOwnedCodeModeSessionProvider::default().
Default host comes from InstallContext; availability checks host_program.is_file().
Without bundled layout, fallback locates codex-code-mode-host next to current executable, including target/debug/deps.
Real new turn copies service availability into turn_context.
Model tool_mode overrides feature request. Unavailable ordinary CodeMode with default fallback becomes Direct; CodeModeOnly stays closed.
Direct mode returns before exec and wait registration.
Missing registered tool becomes model-visible unsupported call result.
Custom payload error is exactly unsupported custom tool call: exec.
Successful runtime result has a prepended status header; direct dispatch error bypasses runtime status formatting.
